title: 第二十四章   新生典礼
content_zh:
长达一个月的赶路，琼霄所在的新生队伍已经赶到了星辰学院，其他的新生队伍也已经尽数到达星辰学院。

    “琼霄，我先回去了，新生人数太多，我还要去忙，你先好好休息吧！”安排好琼霄的住宿后，蓝湘对着琼霄说道。

    “嗯嗯，湘儿不要太累，”说着琼霄抱着蓝湘在其额头上亲了一下。

    “嗯！”蓝湘紧紧搂着琼霄，一片红唇紧紧贴了上去。

    许久……

    “喂，你俩要不要这样，这里可是新生区域啊！腻歪了这么久，还不够啊？”李朗看着这对相拥的男女。

    “搞得跟生离死别似得，又不是以后见不到了！”李朗再度戏谑道。

    “哈哈，要你管，你去找一个啊！”琼霄。

    “额，我服，你俩爱干啥干啥，”李朗顿时泄气道。

    一切事情结束后，蓝湘离开了新生区域，琼霄顿时失落起来，这一个月里，琼霄习惯了有蓝湘在身旁的日子。

    “喂！我说兄弟，男儿志在四方，何必在乎儿女情感！”李朗看着有些失落的琼霄道。

    “你不懂，要是你遇到了你喜欢的女孩子，你就不会这么说了。”

    “真假？”

    “你不信就算了。”

    “额……”

    “好了，不说了，再过两天就是开学典礼，我的好好休息一番，要不然听着那些老头子训话，我会睡着的！”李朗摆摆手道。

    “整天就知道睡！也不知道修炼！”琼霄无语道。

    “睡也是一种修炼好不好！”

    “我服，刚来到星辰学院，对这里都不熟，所以整个星辰学院我谁都不服，我特么就服你。”琼霄翻了翻白眼道。

    “哈哈！服就行！”
content_en:
After a month-long journey, Qiong Xiao's freshman team has arrived at Star College, and all other freshman teams have also arrived at Star College.

    "Qiong Xiao, I'm going back first. There are too many freshmen, and I have to be busy. You should have a good rest first!" After arranging Qiong Xiao's accommodation, Lan Xiang said to Qiong Xiao.

    "Hmm, Xiang'er, don't be too tired," Qiong Xiao said, hugging Lan Xiang and kissing her on the forehead.

    "Yeah!" Lan Xiang hugged Qiong Xiao tightly and pressed her red lips tightly against her.

    For a long time...

    "Hey, do you two want to do this? This is a freshman area! You've been tired for so long, isn't it enough?" Li Lang looked at the man and woman embracing each other.

    "It's like we're parting from life and death, and it's not like we won't see each other again!" Li Lang joked again.

    "Haha, if you want to take care of it, go find one!" Qiong Xiao.

    "Uh, I agree, you two can do whatever you like," Li Lang said in frustration.

    After everything was over, Lan Xiang left the freshman area, and Qiong Xiao suddenly felt disappointed. In this month, Qiong Xiao got used to having Lan Xiang by her side.

    "Hey! Brother, a man has his ambitions in all directions, why should he care about the feelings of his children!" Li Lang said looking at Qiong Xiao who was a little disappointed.

    "You don't understand. If you met a girl you liked, you wouldn't say that."

    "True or false?"

    "Forget it if you don't believe it."

    "Um..."

    "Okay, let's not talk anymore. The opening ceremony will be in two days. I should have a good rest, otherwise I will fall asleep listening to those old men's lectures!" Li Lang waved his hand.

    "I only know how to sleep all day! I don't know how to practice!" Qiong Xiao said speechlessly.

    "Sleeping is also a kind of practice, okay?"

    "I'm convinced. I just came to Xingchen College and I'm not familiar with it, so I don't accept anyone in the entire Xingchen College. I just obey you." Qiong Xiao rolled her eyes and said.

    "Haha! Just obey!"
